latest_cos_commentary.headline: Comcast Business is a major connectivity/SD-WAN provider marketing managed-network solutions specifically to multi-location restaurant and bar operators, ranked #1 in the US for managed SD-WAN.
latest_cos_commentary.genius_exposure: No direct pos/payments overlap — Comcast Business is network infrastructure (connectivity/SD-WAN) that POS and payments systems run on top of; relevant as an infrastructure layer, not a software competitor.
latest_cos_commentary.competitive_timing: Continues to hold top rankings in managed SD-WAN as of 2024-2025 third-party assessments.
latest_cos_commentary.sales_response: Not a POS/payments competitor; may be relevant as an infrastructure partner or dependency in a prospect's tech stack (e.g., network reliability affecting POS/payments uptime).
latest_cos_commentary.risk_and_uncertainty: Rankings and figures come from Comcast's own marketing citing third-party research firms; the original ISG/Vertical Systems Group reports were not independently reviewed.
